args.stdin: SELECT v.record_path FROM product_variants v JOIN product_variant_properties p1 ON v.product_sku = p1.product_sku AND p1.property_key = 'sealant_type' AND p1.property_value_text = :sealant_type JOIN product_variant_properties p2 ON v.product_sku = p2.product_sku AND p2.property_key = 'color_family' AND p2.property_value_text = :color_family WHERE v.brand = :brand AND v.series = :series LIMIT 1;

found.message: The product {brand} {series} with sealant type {sealant_type} and color family {color_family} is available in the catalogue.
